headline: Orders hold the pace; margins still out of step

highlights: CY24 was the apex point for profitability, with a record EBITDA margin of 18.9%.
And, ever since, QCO compliance costs, commodity inflation, higher logistics cost and INR depreciation have pulled the margin down – to 15.8% in CY25 and 13.5% in 9MCY26.
Meanwhile, orders have gone from strength to strength – 9MCY26 inflow of INR 134bn has already surpassed full-CY25 (INR 129bn), led by ~72% growth in electrification order inflow (OI).
Q3CY26 stayed tuned to a similar story: strong OI (+56% YoY), a backlog of INR 129bn (+36% YoY) and revenue growth of 19% YoY, but operational EBITA margin shrank to 12.9% (-50bps YoY).
valuation: Upside risks: 1) Better-than-estimated trajectory of margin improvement; and 2) higher-than-expected order inflow and execution.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
